name: proteintrack-database
description: Production database and data-access layer for ProteinTrack

scripts.reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['proteintrack.db', 'proteintrack.db-wal', 'proteintrack.db-shm', 'test.db', 'test.db-wal', 'test.db-shm'].forEach(f => { try { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.unlinkSync(f); } catch (e) {} });" && npm run migrate && npm run seed
